failureDisposition: First hosted candidate 34840789381 at 9724379e877f2d1358e8384b0529becdb03675de passed, but independent local race validation failed: the 900ms whole-fixture deadline expired at a healthy earlier stage. Repetition then exposed a one-second public-status polling window. Both fixture waits now allow five seconds, with unchanged stage/leakage assertions and separate bounded-probe/cancellation tests. Five race repetitions and the full final local/hosted gates passed. Production deadlines are unchanged; original failed logs are retained. The earlier candidate was not tagged or released.

A linked-worktree local release-ci passed but its four binaries lacked VCS metadata and did not match hosted bytes. It was rejected as release evidence. An independent ordinary clean clone reran the complete gate; all four binaries and the full archive match the hosted candidate byte-for-byte. Only the verified hosted bytes were tested and published.
